column1: # Arroyo-Polonio, Battaglia & Thomas 2026, A&A (arXiv:2603.03129), Table 1 'Observed l.o.s. velocity dispersions and dynamical masses of UFDs' (12 ultra-faint dwarfs; the paper's Appendix A gives the per-galaxy data notes).
# Transcribed 2026-09-28 from the arXiv LaTeX source (e-print 4376586 bytes, sha256 e66502a161682fd4...), fetched with the owner's approval for campaign_fresh_gravity CFG46.
# The correction is STATISTICAL and applies to SINGLE-EPOCH data: a mixture model with the binary velocity distribution of the solar neighbourhood convolved with a Gaussian;
# f = the binary fraction.  sig_lit = the literature value (km/s); sig_fz = f = 0 (no binary correction); sig_f = a flat prior on f; sig_f7 = f = 0.7.
# Each sigma is a posterior median with +/- 1-sigma errors (columns p1/m1); the paper's 3-sigma errors are omitted here.  N = stars used; a12_arcmin = semi-major axis projected half-light radius.
# Caveat: sig_lit for Eri III is a 90% upper value (the paper's footnote a); the paper's Ret II sig_fz differs from the literature (its footnote b).
